legendaryActions.description:
(Action) (Concentration) A Large bramble of roses appears (5ft) in a 30ft radius you can see, for the duration in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. It occupies that space and is invulnerable.

Any enemy that moves to a space within 10 feet radius of the roses for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 20 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. The roses vanishes when it has dealt a total of 70 damage. 

The bramble of roses lasts for 1 minute and does not provide cover
